accepted.s: As on 30 November 2024, the installed power capacity of Andhra Pradesh was approximately:
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh had an installed capacity of 27,392 MW as on 30 November 2024.

accepted.sec: AP installed power capacity - total and source-wise mix

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the December 2025 capacity figure of Andhra Pradesh:
1. It represents installed/contracted capacity.
2. Its value is 21,297.03 MW.
3. The figure is directly comparable on the same basis with the November 2024 total of 27,392 MW.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The December 2025 figure is 21,297.03 MW and is based on installed/contracted capacity. It is not on the same basis as the November 2024 total, so statement 3 is false.
accepted.tq: Separate figures by both their date and measurement basis rather than comparing them mechanically.
accepted.sec: AP installed power capacity - total and source-wise mix

accepted.s: Which one of the following sources does NOT form part of the installed power capacity mix of Andhra Pradesh?

Which of the following statements is correct regarding agricultural and aqua power supply in Andhra Pradesh?

Consider the following statements regarding pumped-storage projects in Andhra Pradesh:

accepted.s: Which statement best reflects the nomenclature issue concerning APCPDCL?
o: APCPDCL stands for Andhra Pradesh Coastal Power Development Corporation Limited.
The abbreviation officially expands only as Andhra Pradesh Central Power Distribution Company Limited in all references.
The abbreviation is given as Andhra Pradesh Central Power Distribution Corporation Limited, although some references use 'Company'.
